title: UNIQON Billing Pro • Android Build 281 (Old Due & Old Customer ID)
highlights: Customer Opening Balance & Old Due: Add and edit pre-existing customer balances directly on mobile — instantly reflects in Customer Ledger and outstanding receivables without affecting sales turnover or GST reports.
Old Customer ID / Ref Code: Record legacy customer codes (e.g. CUST-104 or 52) with badges on customer cards and instant search in mobile billing.
Butter-Smooth Telegram-Style Swipe: Zero-latency 1:1 finger tracking across bottom navigation tabs with PageScrollPhysics and persistent cached screen architecture.
Persistent Red Form Field Validation: Mandatory fields highlight in red until filled.
fixes: Added Opening Balance (₹) field to Mobile Customer Form with automatic OB-XXXX ledger invoice generation.
Added Old Customer ID / Ref Code input field and badge display on customer directory cards.
Enabled Old Customer ID matching and badge in Mobile Sales customer picker.
